summary: Iteration 9 tested Phase B (admin appreciation column + rating-filter Select) and Phase C (Accepter → Planifier l'entretien dialog → interview created + notify candidate). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_bc.py including end-to-end accept→schedule→candidate GET /interviews/me + candidate 'interview' notification. Frontend: rating column renders (e.g. 'rating-user_9286b01dcba5' → 4.5(2)); min_rating=4 filter shrinks list 38 → 4 rows and all remaining rows have rating ≥ 4; accept-btn opens the schedule dialog with pre-filled title 'Entretien — Enseignant(e)'; save-schedule-btn triggers success toast 'Entretien planifié — le candidat a été notifié.' and increments Agenda counter to '6 entretiens planifiés'.

issues: Default view shows current week only; scheduling far-future dates (e.g. 2026-12-20) requires clicking arrows or switching to 'Liste' view to see them. Counter shows correctly but no auto-jump/hint. Minor UX.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:1024 `if min_rating:` will treat min_rating=0 as 'no filter' — fine since Select never sends 0, but explicit `is not None` would be safer.

AdminDashboard.js `accept` (line 395) references `setStatus` declared later in the same component (line 416). Works at runtime (arrow assigned to const, only called on click), but reads oddly — consider hoisting `setStatus` above `accept`.

Two data-testid namespaces overlap under 'rating-*': (1) star buttons rating-1..rating-5 inside the review dialog and (2) per-user rating chips rating-<userId> in Utilisateurs table. Currently they don't collide (different pages) but selectors like `[data-testid^='rating-']` can pick up both. Consider prefixing star buttons as `star-rating-<n>` for clarity.
AdminDashboard.js still ~1149 lines — split recommendation from iter_7/8 still stands (>700 line guideline).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Phase B rating column + filter, Phase C accept→schedule dialog + toast, all PASS)
